comment: Makes her class harder than it needs to be (five essays, a midterm, a final and multiple quizzes). She lost two of my essays and tried to give me a zero on both, Then told the dean that I was to scary to talk to and refused to change my grade. Took a year for her to give me the correct one. Worst and Most Incompetent teacher I have ever had.

Incredibly inconsiderate of students' time outside of class and very rude. She has unclear expectations and my biggest regret is not dropping earlier. She ridicules students in front of everyone and demands more outside of class work than any professor I've ever had.

Pam's expectations are too much for an Intro to Modern Dance class. You have to handwrite four essays, go to off campus concerts, and be able to dance pretty well. Her midterm and final are a lot harder than you would expect, most people got C's on the midterm. You can only miss 2 classes or your grade goes down a lot. Only took this for the gen ed

Very unhelpful and unclear about expectations. The course requires a lot of work for a beginner level dance class. She plays favorites and  grades harshly. She overall was not a very nice person and did not seem to care if students did well or not, unless they were athletes. I would not recommend her class!

Unrealistic expectations for a beginning dance course.  She was not clear about what she wanted in both the dancing and also the writtenresearch components of the class.  She does provides study guides saying exactly what you need to know for the tests. Still, I would not recommend her and everyone I've talked to in her classes regret taking them.
I took beg jazz and adv modern w/ Pam.  She is an amazing teacher. She's very understanding and flexible if you have a problem.  Easy grader and a nice person.  Take her class.

I LOVE HER! I have had no dance experience prior to this and she is so helpful. She guides you through everything and if you ask questions she will take you though it step by step. I loved her class and want to take Intermediate Modern next semester. Amazing

At first I didn't like her and found her cold and harsh but you learn to appreciate her teaching style and her.  She comes up with great similies to help you learn certain moves and is a really nice lady.  You do have to write papers but she knows it is a dance class and is a very easy grader.  Made me LOVE modern dance.

i took intro to jazz.  i learned a LOT about dancing...but she is SO intense.  be prepared for a 5 page research paper, 4 responses to performances, a tough final and an oral presentation, not to mention being graded upon your dancing ability.  if you make the commitment, you will learn a lot about dancing though!  :)
She is the best teacher ever. Take her for an easy A.

pam is COMPLEATLY unreasonable.  not willing to compromise and not understanding.  thinks her class is above god.  watch out.  make sure you are very good at dance and willing to make a HUGE effort before taking this class. i hate her.
